wins.label: Record Revenue Growth
wins.evidence: Total revenue was a record $14.9 billion, up 25% year-on-year

wins.label: AI Revenue Surge
wins.evidence: Q1 semiconductor revenue was $8.2 billion, up 11% year-on-year. Growth was driven by AI as AI revenue of $4.1 billion was up 77% year-on-year.

wins.label: Hyperscale Partner Investment
wins.evidence: Our hyperscale partners continue to invest aggressively in their next generation frontier models, which do require high-performance accelerators as well as AI data centers with larger clusters.

wins.label: R&D Investment Increase
wins.evidence: We're pushing the envelope of technology in creating the next generation of accelerators. We're tapping out the industry's first 2-nanometer AI XPU packaging 3.5D as we drive towards a 10,000 teraflops XPU.

wins.label: Software Growth
wins.evidence: Q1 infrastructure software revenue of $6.7 billion was up 47% year-on-year and up 15% sequentially, exaggerated though by deals, which slipped from Q2 -- Q4 in Q1.

risks.label: Non-AI Semiconductor Slowdown
risks.evidence: Revenue of $4.1 billion was down 9% sequentially on a seasonal decline in wireless.

risks.label: Inventory Challenges
risks.evidence: Resales in industrial were down double digits in Q1 and are expected to be down in Q2.

risks.label: Tariff Uncertainty
risks.evidence: I would say it's really too early to know where we all land.

risks.label: Regulatory Impact
risks.evidence: New frontier models and techniques put unexpected pressures on AI systems. It's difficult to serve all classes of models with a single system design point.

risks.label: Market Volatility
risks.evidence: Broadband, which bottomed in Q4 of 2024, showed a double-digit sequential recovery in Q1 and is expected to be up similarly in Q2 and service providers and telcos step up spending.
